name: Probe
summary: Players hide a secret word and take turns guessing letters in opponents' words to earn points.
rules_text: Each player secretly chooses a 4-12 letter word (no proper nouns) and may add up to 5 dots to disguise length, placing letter cards backwards in a tray so only the owner sees the word. Shuffle Activity Cards face down. On your turn draw an Activity Card and apply its effect, then ask any opponent if they have a specific letter or dot. If yes they must reveal one instance of it. If correct you may continue asking any opponents. If wrong your turn ends and you score the values of letters just revealed. Asking for a dot incorrectly costs 50 points. If you think you know a word with at least 5 hidden cards left you may interrupt any time to guess it sequentially for 100 bonus points, losing 50 if wrong. Bonus 50 for exposing someone's last hidden character. When only one player has hidden characters left, everyone gets two final turns, then that player reveals remainder and earns bonuses. Highest total wins.
